failure_modes: Selecting a temporal_region_index or temporal_teacher_blend choice on unread curve fidelity would alter regional attention without validated sign/rate changes, displacing surrounding coordinates and perturbing the detached teacher prior, with no demonstrated affinity benefit.
Treating the null survival_enrichment_z rows as evidence of a beneficial direction would set priorities from point estimates of selection alone, contrary to H001.
Interpreting a temporal derivative or last-record joint-head credit as a spatial gradient or final affinity label would misstate the reward semantics (F002, F004).
Any temperature edit is an interface violation and is not proposed.
rationale: D1.2: The registered time-conditioned alternatives (C013-C018 temporal_region_index, C019-C021 temporal_teacher_blend) change regional attention or blend a validated observed-node coordinate contrast into the teacher term; they do not change teacher coordinates into velocity targets and are not spatial gradients of a temporal derivative. However, the only temporal evidence available is the summarized curve_support fidelity audit (E2bb8390452ed517a, Ed4e7d28e7b0423e0), whose per-curve sign_changes and rate z-values were not read numerically, so H002's precondition for a time-conditioned rule (validated sign/rate changes within 0.0-0.5) is unverified. D4.1: Against the incumbent (pointcloud_delta_A=1.0, teacher_neighbors=4, static regional attention, no temporal blend), the survival_enrichment_z rows cited (E6eca395904dbab13, E12b8b74b4e20fc75, E5645243a13d0e087, E71d25cdba9aba737, E5a13ce4f320192b7, Ecaf1c89898001196) are all null with CIs spanning zero and q~0.999, and the immediate-selection audit (E2bb8390452ed517a) is a geometric nearest-teacher comparison, not the score-weighted FLOWR reward or its Jacobian. No offered choice (dose C001-C003, region C004-C009, teacher_neighbors C010-C012, temporal C013-C021) has a defensible expected advantage over the incumbent under the affinity-first objective, so retaining the incumbent is the evidence-supported decision. D4.2: Predicted failure of an unsupported edit: changing regional attention or temporal blend without validated per-curve contrast would displace surrounding coordinates (positive surrounding Gaussian weight) and perturb the detached nearest-teacher prior, degrading the primary endpoint affinity while only moving coordinates; coordinate graph change alone is not the failure mechanism, the affinity-first degradation is. This prediction reinforces retain.
